findings.finding: Debt service subtracts the DSCR target rather than dividing NOI by the DSCR.
findings.evidence: = (SUM($B$54:$B$67)-$B$51)-$E$53; cached ~$54.98M. Correct maximum annual debt service at target 1.25× is approx $43.98M using the visible NOI.
findings.proposed_remediation: If E54 represents maximum debt service at target DSCR, use MAX(0, NOI/TargetDSCR); separately compute contractual debt service and actual DSCR.
findings.regression_test: Change coverage target 1.25 to 1.50; allowable debt service must fall, then verify actual NOI / annual payments.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed formula issue; business intent of field should be verified.

findings.finding: Market-rate studio rent uses one-bedroom vacancy rather than studio vacancy.
findings.evidence: =B28*C28*12*(1-D29); D28=3.3%, D29=2.4%; increases the sample studio annual revenue by $38,983.68.
findings.proposed_remediation: Use B28*C28*12*(1-D28) for studios; likewise link every unit-type revenue to its own vacancy and price.
findings.regression_test: Modify studio vacancy only and verify only studio revenue changes.

findings.finding: Most of the maximum-revenue subtotal is static values, not formulas; changing rents or unit counts may leave totals unchanged.
findings.evidence: B55 has a formula but B56:B67 appear as cached hardcoded numbers in the uploaded workbook.
findings.proposed_remediation: Model all line-item potential rental income as unit count × monthly rent × 12 × (1 - vacancy), or NLA × rents with units specified.
findings.regression_test: Change each unit-type rent by 10%; matching annual revenue must adjust proportionally.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed static cells; verify intentional freezes versus live requirements.

findings.finding: Construction interest is a half-draw shortcut without a scheduled debt ledger.
findings.proposed_remediation: Calculate interest per period on opening balance and draws, capitalization, interest-only payments, refinance and repayments; use scenario rates.
findings.regression_test: Front-load and back-load identical construction budgets; interest must differ as timing changes.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed simplified formula, not necessarily arithmetic error.

findings.finding: Displayed FSI is gross construction area divided by lot area; underground space is included in B10.
findings.evidence: =B10/B9; B10=2,303,763 ft², B11=120,039 ft² below grade.
findings.proposed_remediation: Create separate GCA, planning-defined GFA, above-grade GFA, and zoning FSI with jurisdiction-specific exclusions.
findings.regression_test: Changing below-grade garage area must not automatically increase zoning FSI unless applicable bylaw requires it.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed denominator/numerator; jurisdiction-specific zoning definitions require validation.

findings.finding: Actual-development GFA references expected FSI instead of actual input.
findings.evidence: =C15*C17 even though C25 is actual FSI; currently C17=C25=5 so error is masked.
findings.proposed_remediation: Use C24*C25 or the intended actual lot-area reference and actual FSI after confirming which input is canonical.
findings.regression_test: Set expected FSI=5 and actual FSI=4.2; approved GFA must reflect 4.2.

findings.finding: Required parking area materially exceeds modeled underground construction area.
findings.evidence: Parking!C12=71,943.2 ft²; Condo Pro Forma!C29=22,233.6 ft²; 3.24× as much required parking area as single modeled below-grade GFA.
findings.proposed_remediation: Model parking capacity by level, ramp/circulation efficiency, gross area and count; cost all underground floor area.
findings.regression_test: Parking area allocated across subterranean levels must be >= physically required area; fail if mismatch.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed area discrepancy, not proof of undercosting until level count is checked.

findings.finding: Maximum permanent loan ignores the separate LTV constraint.
findings.evidence: =B110 rather than MIN(B110,B112); current sample DSCR limit happens to bind.
findings.proposed_remediation: Use minimum of DSCR-allowable debt, LTV cap, loan-to-cost cap, program/lender limits, with lender-specific fees.
findings.regression_test: Reduce appraised value so LTV limit drops below DSCR amount; permissible loan must fall.

findings.finding: Equity field links to construction loan, causing wrong cash-on-cash denominators.
findings.evidence: B128=B119 ($51.657M) versus computed equity B121=$49.039M; F163 refers to $B$128.
findings.proposed_remediation: Source contributed equity from a single sources-and-uses ledger, then calculate return on actual contributed equity.
findings.regression_test: Increase loan-to-cost and confirm equity denominator decreases while equity and debt fully reconcile.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed wrong reference and affected ratio.

findings.finding: Terminal debt retirement embeds 40-year amortization and 10-year hold as literals.
findings.evidence: =PV(B103,40-10,-B129,0,0); loan term is separately input in B104.
findings.proposed_remediation: Use remaining loan term = loan amortization - elapsed amortizing periods; derive sale date dynamically from timeline.
findings.regression_test: Change B104 or sale year; outstanding balance must update.

findings.finding: Retail rent at construction completion is escalated, but an adjacent capitalization valuation uses pre-escalation NOI.
findings.proposed_remediation: Define valuation date and use forward 12-month NOI as of that date, consistently across residential/retail.
findings.regression_test: Increase pre-completion rental growth; verify valuation reflects it at matching valuation date.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed inconsistent bases; intent of C98 needs clarification.

findings.finding: Several building area and cost results are static rather than linked to floorplate, floor count, cost/sf.
findings.evidence: For example D5=1,650 m² and E5=3, while F5=4,950, G5=53,281.38, H5=$14.65M are static numeric cells.
findings.proposed_remediation: Derive floor area, sqft conversion and costs for every component from live inputs.
findings.regression_test: Double a building floorplate; corresponding area and cost should double, absent other modifiers.

findings.finding: Blanket "No Tax" on residential rental/parking and automatic 13% on other uses can misstate project cash tax.
findings.evidence: Residential rental and parking rows are tagged No Tax, while others add 13% to hard-cost totals.
findings.proposed_remediation: Separate HST incurred, input tax credits, rental self-supply liabilities, federal/provincial rebates and receipt timing with CRA eligibility.
findings.regression_test: Compare a mixed-use taxable/exempt development with fully eligible and ineligible rebates; reconcile tax cash balances.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed oversimplification; exact treatment depends on project and CRA provisions.

findings.finding: Etobicoke 69% affordable-rent field is hardcoded, while neighboring 70%/80% fields refer to ratios in a different geographic block.
findings.evidence: B27=1,900; C27=1,311 (hardcoded 69%), D27=1,330 references C10, E27=1,520 references D10.
findings.proposed_remediation: Use local explicit 69%,70%,80% assumptions or program-defined threshold rules for the applicable geography and vintage.
findings.regression_test: Change local median market rent; all derived affordability tiers must change appropriately.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed mixed static and cross-zone dependencies.

findings.finding: Template represents Affordable Housing Fund as a financing opportunity; CMHC portal closed to new applicants on 2025-12-19.
findings.evidence: AHF scoring calculates repayable and forgivable loan funding; CMHC official funding page confirms portal closed and full commitment.
findings.proposed_remediation: Mark legacy-only; support committed projects historically; direct new-project modeling to currently open programs only.
findings.regression_test: New hypothetical projects must never receive available AHF funding as confirmed new financing.

findings.finding: A municipal grant contribution is hardcoded without connected eligibility, status, or award evidence.
findings.evidence: =890*75000 and comment 890 units × $75,000 from City of Toronto; not evidence of funding award.
findings.proposed_remediation: Represent grants as prospective, applied, conditional, approved and received; link source and award schedule.
findings.regression_test: Mark grant unconfirmed and observe base case exclude it or separate speculative program scenario.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed hardcode; no independent verification of entitlement.

findings.finding: Soft costs and contingency are fixed at 8% and 10% of hard costs.
findings.evidence: =E11*0.08 and =0.1*E11, respectively; whether adequate varies by site, program and scope.
findings.proposed_remediation: Offer configurable ranges and bottom-up components: consultants, permits, insurance, utility connections, contingencies.
findings.regression_test: Change project type and complexity; explain why default assumptions may be invalid.
findings.confidence_note: Confirmed simplified assumptions, not arithmetic errors.

findings.finding: Prime rates are manually entered values and do not carry an effective date/source.
findings.evidence: Condo C70=5.25%; IRR B101=5.25%; 0-baseline E43=5.3%, versus BOC weekly posted major-bank prime 4.45% for 2026-10-14.
findings.proposed_remediation: Pull dated Bank of Canada series; keep lender margin, commitment fee, fixed/variable, reset index and manual override separate.
findings.regression_test: New market observation triggers a clear compare-and-update event; never silently rewrite signed-off scenarios.
findings.confidence_note: Sample rates differ from later posted rate; historical scenarios may intentionally retain earlier rates.

findings.finding: Hardcoded local DC/parkland/CBC values lack governed location and time validity.
findings.evidence: Ontario and municipalities publish time-dependent schedules, discounts, deferrals and exceptions by site/use.
findings.proposed_remediation: Resolve geographic jurisdiction, bylaw, effective date, payment trigger, exemptions and amendments with source snapshot.
findings.regression_test: Alter occupancy date across rate revision; due amount or timing changes only when law requires it.
findings.confidence_note: Design risk based on static rate storage; no finding of a specific incorrect bylaw rate.
